description: This is a C source file implementing a display driver for the OTM8009A display panel in the Zephyr RTOS. It includes functions for initializing the display, writing commands, configuring settings, and controlling backlight and power states.

methods.name: otm8009a_dcs_write
methods.description: Sends a command with optional data over DCS protocol to the display.

methods.name: otm8009a_mcs_write
methods.description: Sends a multi-part command sequence to the display.

methods.name: otm8009a_check_id
methods.description: Reads and verifies the display panel ID.

methods.name: otm8009a_configure
methods.description: Performs the display initialization sequence, configuring registers and settings.

methods.name: otm8009a_blanking_on
methods.description: Turns off the display and backlight.

methods.name: otm8009a_blanking_off
methods.description: Turns on the display and backlight.

methods.name: otm8009a_write
methods.description: Placeholder for writing pixel data to the display (not supported).

methods.name: otm8009a_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as resolution and pixel format.

methods.name: otm8009a_init
methods.description: Initializes the display device, including reset, configuration, and attachment to MIPI-DSI.
